name: TikTok
description: Replies and monitoring for your TikTok account.
author: Nextbrowser Team

watchlist.title: Creators to answer
watchlist.blurb: Accounts whose video comments Nextbrowser answers in your browser profile — usually your own. Every pass finds comments nobody from the account has answered yet, shows you each draft, and posts only the replies you approve.
watchlist.subscribeTask: Add @{handle} to the TikTok reply list: open https://www.tiktok.com/@{handle} in the browser profile, confirm the creator exists, and record @{handle} in the state file with its newest video as the baseline. Reply to nothing, like nothing and follow nobody in this run. If TikTok shows a captcha, stop and tell me.
watchlist.checkTask: Run one reply pass on TikTok in the browser over these accounts: {handles}. Only these accounts are on the list right now. For each, open its three newest videos and find comments newer than the recorded baseline that nobody from the signed-in account has answered. Read each comment and write a reply that answers that specific comment - never a canned line. Show me every draft before anything goes out, then post only the ones I approve with the comment's own Reply button, a few per account, and stop at the first failure or captcha. Update the state file.

signIn.probe: (() => { try { const node = document.getElementById('__UNIVERSAL_DATA_FOR_REHYDRATION__'); const data = node ? JSON.parse(node.textContent || '{}') : {}; const user = ((data.__DEFAULT_SCOPE__ || {})['webapp.app-context'] || {}).user || {}; return { signed_in: !!user.uniqueId, handle: user.uniqueId || '' }; } catch (error) { return { signed_in: false, handle: '' }; } })()
